from.place: Compatibility of prescribed local vector traces on overlaps

title: Compatibility of prescribed local vector traces on overlaps
statement: Under [def-amb-vector-integration-charts], fix alpha:C_pi≅single(L), a normalized Tate transport t, and a normalized projective-line datum family D with its base-change equations. Turn each prescribed trace on a frame open V into a local sheaf map by the actual Hom equivalence, after the inverse constant-object pullback comparison. For two frame opens V,V_prime and every W in S_et with lifts to both, the descentComponent values of these sheaf maps are equal. This states overlap equality only: no concentration, global existence, global uniqueness or normalized identification is in its conclusion. Separate proved uniqueness results imply that all normalized families coincide and force their base-change equations; the proved wrapper therefore gives the same overlap equality for independently specified normalized families without a base-change hypothesis.

source.place: The concentration, overlap, and degree-zero gluing argument

proof.text: Restrict frames to the intersection. Exact inverse image commutes with the Hom correspondence. Compact-support exchange pasting and normalized Tate composition identify the restricted maps with the prescribed affine counits of the restricted frames. The supplied projective-line base-change equation passes to the ordered affine counit by composition of adjunctions.

On the intersection write e_j=e_i G. The coordinate convention gives phi_j=a_(G transpose) phi_i and g=(G transpose)^(-1). The inverse coordinate squares paste to give B_j=rho_g B_i with rho_g the actual affineLinearTraceAction.

Apply affineSpaceLinearTraceInvariance on the Noetherian intersection, where N remains invertible. Pull back the equality to W and evaluate. Full faithfulness and the Hom correspondence give equality of the descent components.

For the wrapper, identify any two normalized Tate transports and then their datum families by the proved uniqueness theorems. Obtain base change from normalization and apply the fixed-family overlap result.

lean.statement:
theorem vectorIntegrationLocalSheafTrace_compatible_of_baseChange (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    {L : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)}
    (α : vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S d F ≅
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t T hT)
    (hD : OrdinaryFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t D)
    (V V' : S.Opens) (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d F V)
    (e' : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d F V')
    (W : S.Etale) (q : W ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk V.ι) (q' : W ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk V'.ι) :
    descentComponent V.ι
        (vectorIntegrationLocalSheafTrace N hN A hA t D S hS d F α V e) q =
      descentComponent V'.ι
        (vectorIntegrationLocalSheafTrace N hN A hA t D S hS d F α V' e') q'
